turns.assessment: The fault localizes to oms.S03-S02.amp1: its input power remained stable while its output fell about 7.17 dB, and essentially the same loss propagated through every downstream amplifier and all monitored channels. The broad, uniform power and OSNR degradation plus AMP_GAIN_OOR directly indicate a gain drop; unchanged pump current and residual output argue against pump failure or pump-current drift.

proposals.rationale: Stable amp1 input with sharply reduced amp1 output directly demonstrates lost gain at this amplifier. Matching downstream power loss, channel-power loss, and OSNR degradation are the documented all-channel effects.
A gain-control defect at amp1 is possible, but gain tilt should affect only part of the band unevenly, whereas the observed reductions are broad and similar across channels.
